text:
If you’re heading out for the last light, plan on a cool, breezy sunset around 7:05, with the northwest wind still noticeable before easing tonight. Skies clear out, and temperatures slip to about 45, so bring a layer for any lingering waterfront plans. On the lake, waves stay around 1 to 2 feet this evening before the wind goes light.

Tuesday starts quietly, then turns breezier under partly sunny skies. The forecast calls for a high near 70, though the models are split, with some keeping us in the mid 60s, so I’d dress for a seasonable day rather than summer warmth. South winds may gust to 24 mph, with lake waves building toward 1 to 3 feet. A shower is possible late Tuesday night, mainly after 2am. Enjoy the clear evening, and be ready for a jacket and a choppier lake by Tuesday afternoon.
